none.means: the ticket tree, the board and the launched sessions; no engine pack

unreal.means: the core, the Unreal pack (editor and Play-In-Editor permits, engine rules, the editor tools) and the Blueprint pack (Blueprint readers that deliver pseudocode and data)

unreal-angelscript.means: the Unreal and Blueprint packs, and the ue-angelscript pack, which reads Script/ and the Blueprint export

browser-game.means: the core and the browser-game pack: a TypeScript game in the browser, its checks, rules and templates
